entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A plane with a reputation as a deathtrap that for millennia served as a prison for the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Colorless astral monstrosities native to the Blind Eternities who have been released from their prison on Zendikar.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes from which the Eldrazi come.

entities.name: Brood lineage
entities.description: The lineage of drones and subordinate beings each colossal Eldrazi spawns, reflecting the progenitor's image.

entities.name: Eldrazi Spawn
entities.description: 0/1 colorless Eldrazi creature tokens that can be sacrificed for mana.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: A colossal colorless Eldrazi given as a Prerelease promotional card.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: A colossal Eldrazi featured on booster art.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: The first Eldrazi previewed from the set, bearing annihilator.

entities.name: Eye of Ugin
entities.description: The seal whose release unleashed the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker dealing with the aftermath of releasing the Eye of Ugin seal in the webcomic.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker who returns as a card and appears in the Enter the Eldrazi webcomic.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker featured as a card in the set.

entities.name: Tuktuk the Explorer
entities.description: A 1/1 Goblin legend that becomes a 5/5 Goblin Golem named Tuktuk the Returned.

entities.name: Enter the Eldrazi
entities.description: A three-part webcomic from April 2010 about Jace and Sarkhan after the seal's release.

events.summary: The Eldrazi, long imprisoned on Zendikar, are released, making the plane's perils deadlier.
Jace and Sarkhan deal with the aftermath of releasing the Eye of Ugin seal.
events.quote: Enter the Eldrazi is a webcomic about Jace and Sarkhan as they deal with the aftermath of releasing the Eye of Ugin seal.

relations.quote: for millennia, the plane has served as a prison for the Eldrazi

relations.note: tokens produced by brood lineage creatures and sacrificed to cast Eldrazi
relations.quote: These 0/1 colorless creatures can be sacrificed to add one colorless mana
